text: The six-wake schedule shall leave no deviation, grade or brief to a single part's choice, and the turn-post yes shall bind only to a verifier on disk.
rationale: Each child closes a door one party could otherwise hold alone.

text: A handed-off day shall go to the next slot in weekday order whose BRIEF.md has no Blocked: line; the giving slot shall not name the receiver.
acceptance: With kit Blocked and rhizome Blocked, a Monday handoff lands on literature; with blank next in order, it is skipped.
rationale: A giver that picks its receiver turns C back into B.

text: The blank slot shall not write a next brief and shall neither give nor receive a day.
acceptance: wakes/blank/ has no BRIEF.md after any Saturday wake; LOG.jsonl has no handoff line to or from blank.
rationale: A blank that briefs itself is a sixth briefed slot by week two.

text: A good day shall count at the review only if a part other than its writer marked it checked: true in the Sunday read.
acceptance: Every good line counted at the 12-30 review has checked: true and a checker different from the writer.

text: Each slot's first Scope: line shall carry a second part's key before 2026-11-30; first briefs shall be split kit+second desk Morphyx, rhizome+dated guess Modulo, literature Mozzie.
acceptance: Five wakes/<slot>/BRIEF.md files dated before 11-30, each with a Scope line and a second signature.
rationale: One author of five scopes gives every slot the same blind spot.

text: The joined-verifier rule shall bind from the first turn after verify-join.mjs is on disk and a second part's clean-copy run shows PASS on true faces and FAIL on one face changed, wrong round, and forged randomness field; until then the second key's why shall say unjoined.
acceptance: A result file with the four cases, the pin print and the second part's name, in research/drand-verify-1117/.
rationale: On 11-23 verify-join.mjs was not in the tree; a rule can't bind to a file nobody can open.

text: At a sitting's close the lab shall move to past/N/proposals/ exactly the papers CHOICE.md lists as settled.
acceptance: The next NEXT.json after this sitting lists none of the papers CHOICE 11-23 names.
rationale: Two papers settled 11-12 sat on the list 11 days because nothing had the job of acting on CHOICE.
